entries.en: Please be quiet during the recording.
entries.zh: 录音时请保持安静。

entries.en: Mia packed bread and cheese for lunch.
entries.zh: 米娅装了面包和奶酪当午餐。

entries.en: The roof of the shed needs repairs.
entries.zh: 棚子的屋顶需要修理。

entries.en: A cyclist stopped to help us.
entries.zh: 一位骑车人停下来帮助我们。

entries.en: We walked to the station after dinner.
entries.zh: 晚饭后我们步行去了车站。

entries.en: The kettle is full, so lift it carefully.
entries.zh: 水壶是满的，拿时要小心。

entries.en: My brother called while he was waiting.
entries.zh: 弟弟等候时打来了电话。

entries.en: I saved a seat for you.
entries.zh: 我给你留了一个座位。

entries.en: Please pass me that blue folder.
entries.zh: 请把那个蓝色文件夹递给我。

entries.en: This key does not fit the lock.
entries.zh: 这把钥匙打不开这把锁。

entries.en: You can borrow my umbrella today.
entries.zh: 你今天可以借我的伞。

entries.en: I share a kitchen with two students.
entries.zh: 我和两名学生共用一个厨房。

entries.en: Your glasses are on the windowsill.
entries.zh: 你的眼镜在窗台上。

entries.en: The guests said they would arrive early.
entries.zh: 客人们说他们会早点到。

entries.en: Please say your name clearly.
entries.zh: 请清楚地说出你的名字。

entries.en: A wooden bench stands by the gate.
entries.zh: 大门旁有一张木凳。

entries.en: This belongs in the recycling bin.
entries.zh: 这个应该放进回收箱。

entries.en: Nina smiled when she saw the cake.
entries.zh: 尼娜看到蛋糕时笑了。

entries.en: Meet me at the library entrance.
entries.zh: 在图书馆入口处等我。

entries.en: The room is small but comfortable.
entries.zh: 房间很小，但是很舒适。

entries.en: We finished the puzzle before dinner.
entries.zh: 我们在晚饭前拼好了拼图。

entries.en: That green bicycle is his.
entries.zh: 那辆绿色自行车是他的。

entries.en: This postcard came from my cousin.
entries.zh: 这张明信片是表姐寄来的。

entries.en: Which would you choose for the cover?
entries.zh: 你会选哪一个做封面？

entries.en: Would you prefer tea or coffee?
entries.zh: 你想喝茶还是咖啡？

entries.en: We used a towel as a curtain.
entries.zh: 我们把一条毛巾当窗帘用。

entries.en: What did you find in the drawer?
entries.zh: 你在抽屉里找到了什么？

entries.en: I would gladly help with the packing.
entries.zh: 我很愿意帮忙打包。

entries.en: The twins left their boots outside.
entries.zh: 双胞胎把靴子留在了外面。

entries.en: Leave the parcel there beside the desk.
entries.zh: 把包裹放在那边桌子旁。

entries.en: Who left this scarf on the chair?
entries.zh: 谁把这条围巾留在椅子上了？

entries.en: I offered three dates, but all were unsuitable.
entries.zh: 我提出了三个日期，但全都不合适。

entries.en: Take an umbrella if the sky looks dark.
entries.zh: 如果天色阴沉，就带把伞。

entries.en: I saw Anna and waved to her.
entries.zh: 我看见安娜，向她挥了挥手。

entries.en: I left my lunch in the fridge.
entries.zh: 我把午餐留在了冰箱里。

entries.en: We talked about our plans for Saturday.
entries.zh: 我们聊了聊周六的安排。

entries.en: Only one window faces the garden.
entries.zh: 只有一扇窗户朝着花园。

entries.en: Can you see the lighthouse from here?
entries.zh: 你从这里看得见灯塔吗？

entries.en: We have enough time for a short walk.
entries.zh: 我们有足够的时间散一会儿步。

entries.en: I bought some apples at the market.
entries.zh: 我在市场买了一些苹果。

entries.en: The lights dimmed when the film began.
entries.zh: 电影开始时灯光暗了下来。

entries.en: She spent a year learning to sail.
entries.zh: 她花了一年时间学习帆船驾驶。

entries.en: Could you hold the door for me?
entries.zh: 你能帮我扶一下门吗？

entries.en: I think the blue design is clearer.
entries.zh: 我认为蓝色的设计更清楚。

entries.en: The cat climbed into an empty box.
entries.zh: 猫爬进了一个空箱子。

entries.en: The dog shook its wet coat.
entries.zh: 狗抖了抖湿漉漉的皮毛。

entries.en: These cups are clean; please put them away.
entries.zh: 这些杯子洗干净了，请把它们收起来。

entries.en: Read the instructions, then connect the cable.
entries.zh: 先读说明，然后接上电缆。

entries.en: Two buses arrived at the same moment.
entries.zh: 两辆公交车同时到了。

entries.en: Please send me the updated timetable.
entries.zh: 请把更新后的时间表发给我。

entries.en: The dog ran out when I opened the door.
entries.zh: 我一开门，狗就跑了出去。

entries.en: Several people waited outside the ticket office.
entries.zh: 几个人在售票处外等候。

entries.en: Please write your address on this label.
entries.zh: 请把你的地址写在这张标签上。

entries.en: The rain has stopped, so we can leave now.
entries.zh: 雨停了，我们现在可以出发了。

entries.en: Leo dropped his pen, and I returned it to him.
entries.zh: 利奥掉了笔，我把笔还给了他。

entries.en: There is no milk left in the fridge.
entries.zh: 冰箱里一点牛奶也没有了。

entries.en: Try the other entrance during repairs.
entries.zh: 维修期间请走另一个入口。

entries.en: The small lift holds only four people.
entries.zh: 这部小电梯只能容纳四人。

entries.en: This suitcase is heavier than mine.
entries.zh: 这个行李箱比我的重。

entries.en: I like reading beside an open window.
entries.zh: 我喜欢坐在开着的窗边读书。

entries.en: We need more chairs for the visitors.
entries.zh: 我们需要给来访者再添些椅子。

entries.en: How do you fold this camping chair?
entries.zh: 这把折叠露营椅怎么收起来？

entries.en: These are the photos from our hike.
entries.zh: 这些是我们徒步时拍的照片。

entries.en: The museum also offers evening tours.
entries.zh: 这家博物馆也提供夜间导览。

entries.en: Choose any of the available seats.
entries.zh: 空着的座位随便选一个。

entries.en: Our kitchen window overlooks the courtyard.
entries.zh: 我们厨房的窗户朝向院子。

entries.en: The hall was very quiet after lunch.
entries.zh: 午饭后大厅非常安静。

entries.en: The new bridge has a separate cycle lane.
entries.zh: 这座新桥设有独立的自行车道。

entries.en: I want a desk near the window.
entries.zh: 我想要一张靠窗的书桌。

entries.en: Drawing a diagram is one way to explain it.
entries.zh: 画图是解释这件事的一种方法。

entries.en: You should check the address before leaving.
entries.zh: 你出发前应该核对地址。

entries.en: We ate indoors because the wind was strong.
entries.zh: 因为风大，我们在室内吃饭。

entries.en: A man in a red coat returned my wallet.
entries.zh: 一位穿红外套的男子还回了我的钱包。

entries.en: The café closes after the last train.
entries.zh: 这家咖啡馆在末班车开走后关门。

entries.en: You can charge your phone here.
entries.zh: 你可以在这里给手机充电。

entries.en: The bakery is between the bank and the florist.
entries.zh: 面包店在银行和花店之间。

entries.en: The only thing missing is a bottle opener.
entries.zh: 唯一缺的东西是开瓶器。

entries.en: Many visitors came by bicycle.
entries.zh: 许多游客是骑自行车来的。

entries.en: Those are the boxes we need upstairs.
entries.zh: 那些是我们要搬到楼上的箱子。

entries.en: Please tell the driver where to stop.
entries.zh: 请告诉司机在哪里停车。

entries.en: We ordered three bowls of soup.
entries.zh: 我们点了三碗汤。

entries.en: I walked back to collect my bag.
entries.zh: 我走回去取我的包。

entries.en: I had never heard such a loud bell.
entries.zh: 我从没听过这么响的铃。

entries.en: Sunlight streamed through the narrow window.
entries.zh: 阳光透过狭窄的窗户照进来。

entries.en: Visitors must sign in at reception.
entries.zh: 访客必须在前台登记。

entries.en: The woman beside me was knitting a scarf.
entries.zh: 坐在我旁边的女子在织围巾。

entries.en: The bakery is still open this evening.
entries.zh: 面包店今晚还开着。

entries.en: Our neighbour brought us some fresh bread.
entries.zh: 邻居给我们送来了一些新鲜面包。

entries.en: The child carefully carried the empty vase.
entries.zh: 孩子小心地端着空花瓶。

entries.en: Life in the village follows a slower rhythm.
entries.zh: 村里的生活节奏更慢。

entries.en: This shelf is too high for me.
entries.zh: 这个架子对我来说太高了。

entries.en: Put the wet towels on the rack.
entries.zh: 把湿毛巾放到架子上。

entries.en: I work in the library on Tuesdays.
entries.zh: 我每周二在图书馆工作。

entries.en: Oh, I left the tickets at home!
entries.zh: 啊，我把票落在家里了！

entries.en: The exhibition features toys from around the world.
entries.zh: 展览展出了世界各地的玩具。

entries.en: Our school has a small vegetable garden.
entries.zh: 我们学校有一个小菜园。

entries.en: Try turning the handle slowly.
entries.zh: 试着慢慢转动把手。

entries.en: Where can I return these books?
entries.zh: 我可以在哪里归还这些书？

entries.en: The instructions seem clear to me.
entries.zh: 我觉得这些说明似乎很清楚。

entries.en: The library uses a simple booking system.
entries.zh: 图书馆使用一套简单的预约系统。

entries.en: We caught the same train yesterday.
entries.zh: 我们昨天乘的是同一班火车。

entries.en: The bicycle was in a poor state.
entries.zh: 这辆自行车状况很差。

entries.en: I never leave candles burning unattended.
entries.zh: 我从不让点着的蜡烛无人看管。

entries.en: Something is rattling inside this box.
entries.zh: 这个箱子里有东西在咔嗒作响。

entries.en: I really enjoyed your talk about maps.
entries.zh: 我确实很喜欢你关于地图的演讲。

entries.en: Most students submitted their work early.
entries.zh: 大多数学生提前交了作业。

entries.en: Yes, the upstairs room is available.
entries.zh: 是的，楼上的房间可以使用。

entries.en: We need another lamp for this corner.
entries.zh: 我们需要给这个角落再添一盏灯。

entries.en: The path was steep; however, the view was lovely.
entries.zh: 小路很陡，然而风景很美。

entries.en: There isn't much space under the stairs.
entries.zh: 楼梯下没有多少空间。

entries.en: Show me the route on your map.
entries.zh: 在你的地图上给我看看路线。

entries.en: The loose handle was our main problem.
entries.zh: 把手松动是我们的主要问题。

entries.en: She rested the ladder against the wall.
entries.zh: 她把梯子靠在墙上。

entries.en: Please read the last sentence again.
entries.zh: 请把最后一句再读一遍。

entries.en: A student showed us around the campus.
entries.zh: 一名学生带我们参观了校园。

entries.en: The spare key is under the flowerpot.
entries.zh: 备用钥匙在花盆下面。

entries.en: Why is the front gate locked?
entries.zh: 为什么前门锁着？

entries.en: The hotel provides a luggage storage service.
entries.zh: 这家酒店提供行李寄存服务。

entries.en: A big cardboard box blocked the doorway.
entries.zh: 一个大纸箱挡住了门口。

entries.en: We held a small party on the terrace.
entries.zh: 我们在露台上办了一个小聚会。

entries.en: Can we talk after your lesson?
entries.zh: 我们能在你下课后谈谈吗？

entries.en: The four guests each brought a dish.
entries.zh: 四位客人每人带来了一道菜。

entries.en: Turn the knob to adjust the volume.
entries.zh: 转动旋钮来调节音量。

entries.en: Every room has a desk and a lamp.
entries.zh: 每个房间都有书桌和台灯。

entries.en: The organisers provide drinking water at the entrance.
entries.zh: 主办方在入口处提供饮用水。

entries.en: Let's start the meeting with your questions.
entries.zh: 这次会议就从你的问题开始吧。

entries.en: The kitchen light is off.
entries.zh: 厨房的灯关着。

entries.en: I'll be away for a week.
entries.zh: 我要离开一周。

entries.en: Each member helped paint the clubhouse.
entries.zh: 每位成员都帮忙粉刷了俱乐部会所。

entries.en: Four mugs fit on this tray.
entries.zh: 这个托盘可以放下四个杯子。

entries.en: He always checks the windows before leaving.
entries.zh: 他出门前总会检查窗户。

entries.en: I can't read this print without my glasses.
entries.zh: 不戴眼镜我看不清这些字。

entries.en: Please return the form within seven days.
entries.zh: 请在七天内交回表格。

entries.en: Phones must stay silent during the performance.
entries.zh: 演出期间手机必须静音。

entries.en: I underlined every unfamiliar word in the article.
entries.zh: 我给文章中每个生词都画了下划线。

entries.en: Although it was late, the café was busy.
entries.zh: 虽然已经很晚，咖啡馆仍很热闹。

entries.en: Her question led to an interesting discussion.
entries.zh: 她的问题引发了一场有趣的讨论。

entries.en: Please arrive before the doors open.
entries.zh: 请在开门前到达。

entries.en: The next bus leaves at half past six.
entries.zh: 下一班公交车六点半发车。

entries.en: We run along the river on Sundays.
entries.zh: 我们每周日沿河跑步。

entries.en: The attic is quite warm in summer.
entries.zh: 阁楼夏天相当暖和。

entries.en: I bought five stamps for these postcards.
entries.zh: 我为这些明信片买了五张邮票。

entries.en: We heard owls calling during the night.
entries.zh: 夜里我们听见猫头鹰在叫。

entries.en: Write your answer below the diagram.
entries.zh: 把答案写在图下面。

entries.en: The entrance is on the left side.
entries.zh: 入口在左侧。

entries.en: She visits her grandparents once a month.
entries.zh: 她每月探望祖父母一次。

entries.en: The post office closes early today.
entries.zh: 邮局今天提前关门。

entries.en: The archive holds more than a million photographs.
entries.zh: 档案馆收藏了一百多万张照片。

entries.en: The storm cut power to our building.
entries.zh: 暴风雨导致我们这栋楼停电。

entries.en: Please fill the jug with cold water.
entries.zh: 请往壶里装满冷水。

entries.en: The smallest room became our study.
entries.zh: 最小的房间成了我们的书房。

entries.en: A young musician played outside the station.
entries.zh: 一位年轻乐手在车站外演奏。

entries.en: I tried two pens, but both were empty.
entries.zh: 我试了两支笔，但两支都没墨了。

entries.en: My mother taught me to sew buttons.
entries.zh: 妈妈教我缝纽扣。

entries.en: We often eat lunch in the courtyard.
entries.zh: 我们经常在院子里吃午饭。

entries.en: I keep some money for unexpected expenses.
entries.zh: 我留了一些钱应付意外开销。

entries.en: Grandpa told a story about his first job.
entries.zh: 爷爷讲了他第一份工作的故事。

entries.en: This book has a map inside the cover.
entries.zh: 这本书的封面内侧有一张地图。

entries.en: The birds flew away as we approached.
entries.zh: 我们走近时鸟儿飞走了。

entries.en: A lot of dust settled on the shelves.
entries.zh: 架子上积了很多灰尘。

entries.en: I study French for half an hour daily.
entries.zh: 我每天学习半小时法语。

entries.en: Take the second street on the right.
entries.zh: 在右边第二条街拐进去。

entries.en: Though the flat is old, it feels welcoming.
entries.zh: 虽然这套公寓很旧，却让人感到亲切。

entries.en: Their car was parked beside the bakery.
entries.zh: 他们的车停在面包店旁边。

entries.en: Perhaps the spare cable is in my bag.
entries.zh: 备用电缆也许在我包里。

entries.en: The library has a clear policy on noise.
entries.zh: 图书馆对噪声有明确规定。

entries.en: He wore a black coat to the concert.
entries.zh: 他穿着一件黑色外套去听音乐会。

entries.en: The weekend market sells local vegetables.
entries.zh: 周末集市出售本地蔬菜。

entries.en: I've already washed the dishes.
entries.zh: 我已经洗好碗了。

entries.en: Nothing was left in the drawer.
entries.zh: 抽屉里什么都没剩下。

entries.en: The shop has been closed since Monday.
entries.zh: 这家店从周一开始就一直关着。

entries.en: The paint hasn't dried yet.
entries.zh: 油漆还没有干。

entries.en: We planted lavender around the patio.
entries.zh: 我们在露台周围种了薰衣草。

entries.en: The final result surprised the whole team.
entries.zh: 最终结果让全队都很惊讶。

entries.en: I asked whether the museum opened on Mondays.
entries.zh: 我问了博物馆周一是否开放。

entries.en: You can sit beside the window.
entries.zh: 你可以坐在窗边。

entries.en: The exhibition runs until the end of May.
entries.zh: 展览一直持续到五月底。

entries.en: Please stand behind the yellow line.
entries.zh: 请站在黄线后面。

entries.en: Draw a straight line across the page.
entries.zh: 在纸上画一条横向直线。

entries.en: Our report includes photos of the damaged roof.
entries.zh: 我们的报告附有受损屋顶的照片。

entries.en: I found my keys among the receipts.
entries.zh: 我在一堆收据中找到了钥匙。

entries.en: The hall was almost empty by nine.
entries.zh: 到九点时，大厅几乎空了。

entries.en: Have you ever stayed in a lighthouse?
entries.zh: 你曾经在灯塔里住过吗？

entries.en: Bad weather delayed the outdoor concert.
entries.zh: 恶劣天气使露天音乐会推迟了。

entries.en: This road leads to the old harbour.
entries.zh: 这条路通往老港口。

entries.en: Ben repaired the broken chair himself.
entries.zh: 本自己修好了坏椅子。

entries.en: We carried the heavy table together.
entries.zh: 我们一起搬了那张沉重的桌子。

entries.en: Six candles stood in a neat row.
entries.zh: 六支蜡烛整齐地排成一行。

entries.en: The transport minister answered questions about rail services.
entries.zh: 交通部长回答了关于铁路服务的问题。

entries.en: The workshop can produce twenty chairs a week.
entries.zh: 这家工坊每周能制作二十把椅子。

entries.en: The printer works at a steady rate.
entries.zh: 打印机以稳定的速度运行。

entries.en: I've only visited that gallery once.
entries.zh: 那家美术馆我只去过一次。

entries.en: White curtains softened the afternoon sunlight.
entries.zh: 白色窗帘让午后的阳光柔和了些。

entries.en: Of these rooms, I use the attic least.
entries.zh: 这些房间里，我使用阁楼最少。

entries.en: Her office has a view of the river.
entries.zh: 她的办公室能看见河流。

entries.en: The club president welcomed our newest members.
entries.zh: 俱乐部会长欢迎了新成员。

entries.en: The novel follows a family separated by war.
entries.zh: 这部小说讲述一个被战争拆散的家庭。

entries.en: Our team designed the posters for the fair.
entries.zh: 我们团队为集市设计了海报。

entries.en: Only one person can use this lift at a time.
entries.zh: 这部升降机一次只能载一个人。

entries.en: The main reason for moving was the noise.
entries.zh: 搬家的主要原因是噪声。
